abstract: AIMS: Human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) is a useful marker for chorionic proliferative disorders, such as choriocarcinoma. Although hCG synthesis in lung cancers is frequent, primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma (PCC) is rare. To clarify the differences between primary choriocarcinoma and hCG-producing giant cell carcinoma (GCC) of the lung, we compared the clinicopathological and immunohistochemical findings of these tumours. METHODS AND RESULTS: Three patients, one with PCC and two with hCG-producing GCC, were included in this study. They were all middle-aged men and habitual smokers. The growth of these tumours and the progression of the clinical courses were extremely rapid, and the patients all died within 8 months after the pulmonary tumours were found. Haemorrhagic appearance was a common macroscopic feature of the specimens obtained. Microscopically, both types of tumours mainly consisted of atypical polygonal cells. While PCC contained many syncytial trophoblast-like multinucleated cells that had strong immunoreactivity for anti-hCG, such cells were relatively few in hCG-producing GCC. These histological and immunohistochemical findings reflected the serum test result for hCG, which was higher in the case of PCC. CONCLUSIONS: There are a few differences between PCC and hCG-producing GCC, as described above. Reliable distinction between them seems to be difficult for pathologists and worthless for clinicians.
abstract_ja:
背景：ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は、絨毛癌などの絨毛性増殖性疾患の有用な腫瘍マーカーである。肺癌ではhCGの合成が頻繁にみられるが、原発性肺絨毛癌(PCC)は稀である。原発性肺絨毛癌とhCG産生巨細胞癌(GCC)の違いを明らかにするため、これらの腫瘍の臨床病理学的および免疫組織化学的所見を比較した。
方法と結果：PCC1例とhCG産生GCC2例の計3例を対象とした。いずれも中高年男性の習慣的喫煙者であった。これらの腫瘍の増大と臨床経過の進行は極めて速く、肺病変の発見後8か月以内に全例が死亡した。検体では出血性の肉眼所見が共通してみられた。顕微鏡的には、両タイプとも異型のある多角形細胞から主に構成されていた。PCCでは抗hCG抗体に強陽性を示す多数の合胞体性栄養膜様多核細胞が認められたが、hCG産生GCCではそのような細胞は比較的少なかった。これらの組織学的・免疫組織化学的所見は、血清hCG検査結果を反映しており、PCCの方が高値であった。
結論：上記のようにPCCとhCG産生GCCの間にはいくつかの違いがあるが、病理医にとって両者を確実に区別することは困難であり、臨床医にとっても区別の意義は乏しいと思われる。
